headline: BPM MINERALS HITS 20.57 G/T AU OVER 4M AT CLYDE — First Holes at WA's Bonnie & Clyde Return High-Grade Intercepts From 39m
snippet: BPM Minerals (ASX: BPM) returned 4m at 20.57 g/t gold from 39m depth at its Clyde prospect in Western Australia, with 27 of 65 planned holes still awaiting results. The intercept includes a 1m zone grading 73.33 g/t gold, confirming the Bonnie & Clyde anomaly warrants aggressive follow-up.

headline: AUKING MINING HITS 67M @ 1.68% TREO AT UNTESTED TUNDULU ZONE — Malawi REE Discovery Extends 1km East of Main Target
snippet: AuKing Mining (ASX: AKN) has intercepted 67m grading 1.68% total rare earth oxide from surface at a previously undrilled zone 1km east of the Nathace Hill target at Tundulu, Malawi. The hit extends the known carbonatite footprint and puts AuKing on a path toward its maiden resource estimate in Q4 2026.

headline: GOLD TESTS $3,970 AS DEMOCRATS SCORE MIDTERM WINS — USD Sells Off as Split Congress Outcome Boosts Safe-Haven Bid
snippet: Spot gold pushed toward $3,970 resistance on the morning of November 4 as Democrats secured early midterm wins and the US dollar weakened. A divided Congress outcome reduces the probability of further fiscal tightening, which historically supports precious metals — but NFP data on Friday remains the next key hurdle.

headline: B2GOLD REPORTS Q3 AFTER CLOSE TODAY — $828M Revenue, $0.10–0.12 EPS Expected; Dividend Sustainability the Burning Question
snippet: B2Gold (TSX/NYSE: BTG) releases Q3 2026 results after North American markets close today, with consensus at $0.10–0.12 EPS and revenue near $828M. Investors are watching whether the dividend — already cut earlier this year — remains covered after Q2's production miss and rising AISC.

headline: ALBEMARLE Q3 EARNINGS TONIGHT — Lithium Giant Eyes $2.39 EPS Swing From Year-Ago Loss as Carbonate Prices Stabilize
snippet: Albemarle (NYSE: ALB), the world's largest lithium producer, reports Q3 2026 earnings after the market close today, with the call on November 5. Analysts expect a $2.39 EPS profit versus a year-ago loss; the report will test whether Citi's recent 40% forecast cut to $12,000/t carbonate is baked in or still a shock waiting to land.

headline: COPPER REBOUNDS ABOVE $14,000 AFTER 11-WEEK LOW — LME Bounces From $13,883 as Morgan Stanley Holds Q4 Target $14,800/T
snippet: LME three-month copper recovered above $14,000/t after touching $13,883 on November 3, its lowest since mid-August, as AI-spending fears that triggered the tech selloff began to fade. Morgan Stanley maintains a Q4 average target of $14,800/t, citing physical tightness in China where the Yangshan copper premium hit a decade-high $200/t last week.

headline: RARE EARTH AMERICAS BOOSTS ALPHA LEACH RECOVERY IN BRAZIL — Ionic Clay Project Closes Gap on Process Economics
snippet: Rare Earth Americas announced improved metallurgical leach recovery results at its Alpha ionic adsorption clay project in Bahia, Brazil, moving the project closer to economic viability. The ionic clay method mirrors Chinese processing of heavy rare earths — a supply source the West is urgently trying to replicate outside China ahead of the November 10 export control deadline.

headline: FALCON METALS POSTS SECOND OLSEN WELL HIT — 16M @ 2.2 G/T AU FROM 8M CONFIRMS WA GOLD DISCOVERY CONTINUITY
snippet: Falcon Metals (ASX: FAL) confirmed the continuity of its Olsen Well gold discovery in Western Australia with a second RC hole returning 16 metres at 2.2 g/t gold from just 8 metres depth. The shallow high-grade hit keeps open-pit economics in play and suggests the deposit is tracking toward a maiden resource.

headline: BARRICK SETS NOVEMBER 9 FOR Q3 2026 RESULTS — Consensus EPS $1.13; Fourmile JV Contribution and North America IPO Timeline in Focus
snippet: Barrick Mining (NYSE: GOLD / TSX: ABX) will publish Q3 2026 results before markets open on November 9, with a webcast at 11:00 AM ET. Analyst consensus sits at $1.13 EPS; key agenda items include the Fourmile contribution to the Nevada Gold Mines JV following the August $1.95B Newmont deal and an update on the planned North American assets IPO.

headline: GOLD'S FINAL SHAKEOUT? ANALYST TARGETS $3,800 BOTTOM BEFORE CYCLE TURN — December Fed Decision Is the Make-or-Break Date
snippet: An FXEmpire analyst argues gold's October–November slide is a final flush rather than a trend reversal, flagging $3,800 as the likely washout low before the next bull leg. The bear scenario requires both a Democratic congressional sweep and a December Fed rate hike — with early midterm results now pointing against the first condition, the floor may be closer than it looks.

headline: DEMOCRATS SCORE EARLY MIDTERM WINS — USD Weakens as Divided Government Scenario Strengthens; Commodities Catch a Bid
snippet: Early November 4 midterm results show Democrats winning several key Senate and House races, dragging the US dollar lower and opening a window for commodity prices. A divided Congress reduces the odds of further fiscal tightening and is historically associated with USD softness that supports both gold and industrial metals.

headline: DUNDAS MINERALS DRILLS 10M @ 1.1 G/T AU NEAR KALGOORLIE — Capricorn Campaign Delivers Hits Across 20 Holes
snippet: Dundas Minerals (ASX: DUN) reported results from 20 holes at its Capricorn project near Kalgoorlie, Western Australia, with the best hit returning 10 metres at 1.1 g/t gold from 138 metres. The project adds to the growing pipeline of early-stage gold explorers generating assays in WA's tier-1 Eastern Goldfields corridor.
